name: 内部银行业务 (6BP)
description_en_html:
Overview

In-house banking offers bank accounts for all subsidiaries in different account currencies. Subsidiaries send their payment files using standard payment processes offered within financial accounting. In-house banking sends electronic bank statements back to clear the open items accordingly.

In-house banking supports payments between subsidiaries (intercompany payments and cross-bank are intercompany payments), payments towards external business partners (payments on behalf), and central incoming payments (for example, resulting from external zero balancing postings).

In-house banking is fully embedded into SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and benefits from the scope of features involved.

In-house banking offers the calculation of interests and fees on internal bank accounts. With help of limits that can be assigned to the internal bank accounts, the cash situation can be monitored easily.

The financial accounting of the in-house banking owner is automatically updated via the general ledger transfer.

Key Process Flow

  • Create internal bank accounts either individually or via mass creation
  • Assign interest conditions to internal bank accounts
  • Assign interest conditions backdated either within the current settlement period or within an already settled period
  • Assign withholding tax calculation if needed
  • Assign maintenance fees and transaction fees to internal bank accounts
  • Assign maintenance fees and transaction fees backdated either within the current settlement period or within an already settled period
  • Assign limits and backdated limits
  • Conduct account settlement simulation to either forecast interest and fees for the current period or to analyze past periods
  • Conduct payments between subsidiaries within one in-house bank area (intercompany payments) or between more than one in-house bank area (cross-bank area intercompany payments)
  • Conduct payments towards external business partners (payments on behalf)
  • Conduct central incoming payments (for example resulting from external zero balancing postings)
  • Conduct internal cash pooling
  • Conduct interest compensation
  • Create correction postings for interests, with holding tax, maintenance fees and transactions fees, initial balance and correction for central incoming payment including back dated value date
  • Get an overview of payments, end-of-day processes, overdraft accounts, and the current bank balance for the respective bank area with help of the In-House Banking Dashboard.
  • Close an internal bank account and transfer the positive account balance either to another in-house bank account within the same bank area or to an external house bank account
  • Perform end-of-day processes including interest and fee calculation, withholding tax calculation, creation of internal bank statements and balance notifications, updating the financial accounting system of the in-house bank owner with help of the general ledger transfer
  • Perform an automatic or manuell resettlement process to recalculate the account settlement of already settled periods related to backdated postings

Business Benefits

  • Settle intercompany account payables and receivables in a cashless manner
  • Monitor payments centrally
  • Track the cash situation on internal bank accounts, including internal limit considerations
  • Maintain accounts using mass creation tools
  • Maintain accounts using eBAM integration
  • Provide bank statements for in-house banking accounts within the day
  • Transfer all postings on in-house banking accounts to the general ledger once a day or within the day
  • Integrate in-house banking fully into standard financial accounting processes for payments and electronic bank statements
description_zh_html:
概览

内部银行为所有子公司提供不同账户货币的银行账户。子公司使用财务会计中提供的标准付款流程发送付款文件。内部银行发送回电子银行对账单以相应地清算未清项目。

内部银行支持子公司之间的付款（公司间付款和跨银行是公司间付款）、向外部业务伙伴付款（代付款）和集中收款（例如，由外部零余额过账产生）。

内部银行完全嵌入 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中，并从所涉及的功能范围中受益。

内部银行提供内部银行账户利息和费用计算。借助可分配到内部银行账户的限额，可以轻松监控现金状况。

内部银行所有者的财务会计通过总账传输自动更新。

关键流程流

  • 单独或通过批量创建创建内部银行账户。
  • 将利息条件分配到内部银行账户
  • 在当前结算期间内或已结算期间内，回溯分配利息条件
  • 根据需要分配代扣税计算
  • 将维护费用和交易费用分配到内部银行账户。
  • 在当前结算期间内或已结算期间内，分配回溯的维护费用和交易费用
  • 分配限额和回溯限额
  • 执行账户结算模拟，以预测当前期间的利息和费用或分析过去期间
  • 在一个内部银行范围内的子公司之间进行付款（公司间付款）或在多个内部银行范围之间执行付款（跨银行范围公司间付款）
  • 向外部业务伙伴付款（代表付款）
  • 执行集中收款（例如，由外部零余额过账产生）
  • 执行内部现金池
  • 执行利息补偿
  • 为含持有税、维护费用和交易费用、初始余额以及集中收款更正（包括回溯起息日）的利息创建更正过账
  • 借助内部银行业务仪表盘，获取相应银行范围的付款、日终流程、透支账户和当前银行余额的概览。
  • 关闭内部银行账户，并将正科目余额传输到同一银行范围内的其他内部银行账户或外部开户行账户
  • 执行日终流程，包括利息和费用计算、代扣税计算、创建内部银行对账单和余额通知，借助总账转账更新内部银行所有者的财务会计系统
  • 执行自动或手动重新安置流程，以重新计算与回溯过账相关的已结算期间的账户结算

业务优势

  • 以无现金方式结算公司间应付账款和应收账款。
  • 集中监控付款
  • 跟踪内部银行账户的现金情况，包括内部限额注意事项
  • 使用批量创建工具维护科目
  • 使用 eBAM 集成维护账户
  • 提供当天内部银行账户的银行对账单。
  • 每天或当天一次，将内部银行账户的所有过账传输到总账
  • 将内部银行业务完全集成到付款和电子银行对账单的标准财务会计流程中。
